subject: Re: Floy + Encord - User Count
text:
Hey Arisha,

I hope you are having a great time in Germany!
I removed as many users as I was able to. There really were some
unnecessary ones or former employees, so thanks as well for the list of
active users!
For a few unfortunately I do not seem to have the rights to remove them.
Could you please help me to do that for the following users:

oliver.borchers@floy.com

paul.brachmann@floy.com

robert.west@floy.com

kyrylo.lavrynenko@floy.com
kajo.kratzenstein@floy.c <kajo.kratzenstein@floy.com>om
aurobrata.ghosh@floy.com

andrei.goncharov@floy.com

luca.steingen@floy.com

maximilian.miller@floy.com

leander.maerkisch@floy.com

goktug.asci@floy.com

The remaining staff is divided as following:

*Annotators/Reviewers*: 22 seats

*Product Managers/Technicians/HR*: 14 seats

So in total we currently have 22 people really using Encord as an
annotation platform and the remaining 14 accounts belong to staff members
who are involved solely in administrative tasks such as data upload,
download, and project organization/ progress survey. They do not use the
annotation or review tools and therefore do not generate annotation-related
activity on the platform.

Given that these accounts do not contribute to annotation or review
workflows, I think they should not be counted towards the total number of
seeds or billed in the same way as active users. I would appreciate it if
you could confirm whether it is possible to keep our billing to reflect
only the 22 active annotators/reviewers until we would exceed that
number. Alternatively, we can discuss how best to align the seat number
needed and platform usage but for that I would include our Finance lead for
the meeting.

Kind regards,

Patrick
